description: Short, flat, unfiltered cigarettes in a paper pack. You get bits of tobacco on your lip and the whole of the smoke.

overdose.message: Your head goes light and grey at the edges and your mouth tastes of pennies.

phases.comeup_message: You light up and draw deep. Your shoulders drop; the edge comes off your hunger.
end_message: Down to the filter. You think about the next one.
It's finished. Only the taste is left.
Gone. You already know how long it is until the next one.
peak_message: The nicotine hits and you relax a little.
The first drag hits, and the craving stops.
Your hands are busy and your head goes quiet.

effects.take_line: You light an unfiltered cigarette and pick a shred of tobacco off your lip.

withdrawal.message: Your hands keep going to a pocket that has nothing in it, and going again a minute later.

stages.easing: Your hands find other things to do, badly.
stages.onset: Your hand reaches for a cigarette that isn't there.
stages.peak: You've reached for the empty pocket eleven times in the last hour, and you're doing it again.
stages.rising: It keeps happening: pocket, mouth, pocket, before you remember.
stages.tail: You've mostly stopped reaching. Once an afternoon, your hand still goes to your pocket.

name: unfiltered cigarettes
